## Evidence-contract effect

Describe what changes for users, rules, policies, schemas, digests, or canonical
results.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes.
- [ ] New or changed rules have executable outcome examples.
- [ ] Unknown evidence remains `cantTell`, `untested`, or `Inconclusive`.
- [ ] No supplied script executes and no supplied URL is fetched.
- [ ] Canonical output contains no time, randomness, locale text, or machine path.
- [ ] Human review requirements are stated and preserved.

## Release impact

State whether this changes a rule version, severity, policy, schema, standards
snapshot, package contents, or migration guidance.
